sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion at this exact site
sites.functional_impact_measured: Immunofluorescence in non-permeabilized cells confirmed plasma membrane localisation of mCherry-ABCB4-FLAG-WT (L4); the construct served as the wild-type reference in a functional HCS assay distinguishing total from cell-surface transporter (L2). No reduction in surface expression or transport activity relative to untagged ABCB4 is reported for the WT construct.
sites.rationale: Python lookup confirms seq[98]='S' and seq[99]='L', exactly matching the paper's stated junction (Ser99–Leu100). Position 99 lies within ECL1 (topology 76–116), 24 residues from the TM1 C-boundary (75) and 18 residues from the TM2 N-boundary (117), well clear of both TM walls. The same junction is independently corroborated by L2, L4, and L5, all from full-length, membrane-anchored constructs expressed in mammalian cells. Validation is scored surface_only because plasma membrane presence is directly demonstrated by immunofluorescence; functional transport activity of the tagged WT is not explicitly quantified in the cited papers. Full-length human ABCB4 with FLAG (DYKDDDDK) inserted between Ser99 and Leu100 in the first extracellular loop (ECL1, topology span 76–116), expressed in mammalian cells; construct pcDNA3-ABCB4-FLAG and its mCherry-ABCB4-FLAG-WT derivative were used for high-content screening and immunofluorescence.

sources.claim: Two different constructs encoding human ABCB4 were used: pcDNA3-ABCB4, which was previously described [ 28 ], and pcDNA3-ABCB4-FLAG, a modified version of ABCB4 with a FLAG tag (DYKDDDDK) within its first extracellular loop (between Ser 99 and Leu 100), prepared by Genscript (Piscataway, NJ, USA).

sites.evidence_type: topology inference (C-terminal snorkel — no accessible terminus)
sites.rationale: C-terminus not extracellular (topology 'I' at residue L) and no accessible N-terminus — C-terminal snorkel presents the tag on the surface via a TM-snorkeling linker (fallback: no natively accessible terminus)

literature_notes: L3 and L5 describe an mCherry tag at the N-terminus of ABCB4. The topology landmarks place residues 1–54 in the intracellular compartment, so this N-terminal mCherry is on the cytoplasmic face and is recorded in other_positions rather than sites. L2, L4, and L5 all corroborate the same Ser99–Leu100 FLAG junction already grounded in L1; they add confidence but do not define a second distinct site. No other extracellular insertion positions are named in the ledger.

literature_other_positions.note: mCherry fused to the N-terminus of ABCB4; topology landmarks place residues 1–54 in the intracellular compartment, so this tag faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface.
